notes_for_editor: Thin: one list entry (tnlandforms GA186) with name, county, coordinates, an elevation value the page gives no unit for (the record's 82.9 m assumes feet), and gfc 230. The page's notes say gfc numbers come from an older GFC list of 203 towers; GFC is not spelled out on the page, so the story keeps the abbreviation. The cited Georgia page does not name Tom Dunigan (the name appears only on sibling tnlandforms pages), so the story and footnote omit it. I read the full 29-name NHLR Georgia list: ochlocknee is not on it, and Thomas (Thomasville) Lookout Tower is. No build, staffing, fate or site description found in two searches and the register pages. A search snippet pointed to WJEP-AM (Ochlocknee), a broadcast tower near the town, which is not a lookout; do not confuse it with this record. Lead for a human: the Georgia Forestry Commission Thomas County office. Story is about 141 words.
